BROADCAST_COMPANIES.DESCRIPTION: Sends one message now to every contact that has the chosen company registered. There is no schedule.
BROADCAST_COMPANIES.EMPTY: No contact has a company registered yet. Fill in the "Company" field on the contacts.
BROADCAST_COMPANIES.SEND_DESCRIPTION: The message goes now to the {count} contacts of the company {company}. Each contact gets a new conversation sent by Chip.
